sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by its action on the nervous system. It is especially useful in cases of nervous disorders and hysteria. There is a general feeling of agitation and restlessness. It is also useful in cases of headaches and insomnia in nervous people.
sections.Mind: Nervous and agitated. Restless. Irritable. Insomnia.
sections.Head: Neuralgic pains in the head. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead.
